I've made all the changes you asked for. They're in one tar.gz with 84 changed or new files. Extract it at the repo root, then rebuild with `scripts/instance.sh up`.

**Delete these files:**
- `src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/Infrastructure/KeyedCooldowns.cs`
- `src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/Nest/INestJournal.cs`
- `tests/MyBlazorPlayground.Web.Tests/Chaos/ClockAndCooldownTests.cs` (it's now `ClockTests.cs`)

**Why the site was broken.** The Containerfile restores packages using only the `.csproj` files, before any `.razor` files are copied in. Without them, the .NET SDK decides the app doesn't need Blazor's framework scripts. So the published image silently shipped without `blazor.web.js`. The browser got a "not found" HTML page in its place and refused to run it, so nothing interactive worked. That's why the Open button stayed disabled. I confirmed this with the real .NET 11.0.100 SDK. The fix is one line in the web `.csproj` (`RequiresAspNetWebAssets`). The container build now also fails if `blazor.web.js` is missing, so this can't happen silently again.

**The inline-script warning** comes from a script Cloudflare injects into pages, not from the site. Blocking it is harmless. Pages now also send a header (`Cache-Control: no-transform`) that asks Cloudflare not to rewrite them.

**Two-step sign-in (optional).** It's on the account page:
- **Setup:** scan a QR code with any authenticator app, or type the key, then enter a code to confirm. You get 10 one-time recovery codes.
- **Signing in:** after the password, the site asks for a 6-digit code or a recovery code. Each code works only once.
- **Managing it:** turning it off or getting new recovery codes needs your password. Turning it on or off signs that account out on other devices.
- **Admins** can turn it off for someone who lost their phone.
- It works on any tunnel address, and there are no passkeys.

**Everything is now saved in PostgreSQL.** Board messages, slot spins, latency runs, canvas strokes and resets, and postcards with their images are all stored. On startup each toy reloads from the database, so restarts lose nothing. The pages still show the same small live window as before. Rate limits stay in memory because they aren't data.

**The 5-minute latency cooldown is gone.** Only the 10-second gap between tests remains.

**Responsiveness.** At iPhone SE width (375 px):
- The nav wraps into a grid instead of scrolling sideways.
- The header no longer sticks to the top on phones.
- Tabs wrap onto a second line.
- Admin and project-member tables stack into label/value blocks.
- The misaligned Name and Key fields on `/work` were one CSS rule. Fixing it there fixes every form on the site.

I checked 21 pages at that width and none scroll sideways.

**Docs:** two new decision records, 0014 (two-step sign-in) and 0015 (toys in PostgreSQL), which replaces 0008. I also updated 0005, 0006, 0010, 0011, 0020, the README and the About page to say everything persists to PostgreSQL. `nytimes.txt` isn't in the GitHub repo yet; the docs now say it's at `src/MyBlazorPlayground.Web/wwwroot/nytimes.txt`, so make sure it goes there when you push. The container build will pick it up.

**Testing:** I built everything with warnings as errors, using the real database driver and Dapper (built from source, since nuget.org isn't reachable from here) against a real PostgreSQL 18. All tests pass: domain 119, web 371, data 21, JavaScript 311. I also walked through two-step sign-in in a browser: setup, wrong code, reused code, recovery code, new codes, turning it off. Reloading toys after a restart worked too.

Two things I couldn't run here:
- **The fix itself:** I confirmed the settings change, but couldn't build the actual image. The framework scripts come from a nuget.org package I couldn't download.
- **Your test run:** I used my own minimal test runner, so the real xUnit code checks didn't run. Run `scripts/test.sh` before deploying.

Once it's deployed, `/homes` should enable Open when you paste the Redfin link.

# myblazorplayground — session notes

## First delivery (2026-11-19)

Full tar.gz (358 files). Domain / Data (Npgsql + Dapper, own migration runner) / Web (Work, Nest=homes, Chaos=toys, Identity, Administration). Ports 8090/5433, compose project `myblazorplayground`, tunnel container `myblazorplayground-tunnel`. `/setup` needs the one-time code from the log.

## Second delivery (2026-11-19, myblazorplayground-update2.tar.gz, 84 files)

- Root cause of the dead site: the Containerfile restores with only the .csproj files, so the SDK inferred `RequiresAspNetWebAssets=false`, never restored `Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Internal.Assets`, and `publish --no-restore` silently shipped without `_framework/blazor.web.js` (404 -> HTML -> nosniff block -> no interactivity, Open button disabled). Fix: `<RequiresAspNetWebAssets>true</RequiresAspNetWebAssets>` in the Web csproj plus a publish-time guard in the Containerfile. The inline-script CSP warning is Cloudflare's injected script; HTML now sends `Cache-Control: ... no-transform`.
- Optional TOTP two-step sign in (ADR 0014): Domain `Totp`, `Base32`, `RecoveryCodes`, `Graphics/QrCode` (own QR encoder, inline SVG); migration 0003; `TwoFactorStore`; `TwoFactorService`; `/account/sign-in/code`; admin reset.
- Toys persist to PostgreSQL (ADR 0015, supersedes 0008): migration 0004; stores in `Data/Toys`; generic `WriteBehindJournal<T>` + `IStateLoader` (Nest refactored onto them).
- Latency per-client 5-minute cooldown removed (gap between runs stays). Reply is `ok <id>`.
- Responsive: nav wraps into a grid on phones, header not sticky under 40rem, tabs wrap, admin/settings tables stack, `.field { align-content: start }` fixes the Name/Key misalignment.
- Deleted: `Infrastructure/KeyedCooldowns.cs`, `Nest/INestJournal.cs`, `tests/.../Chaos/ClockAndCooldownTests.cs` (now `ClockTests.cs`).

Verified in the sandbox with real Npgsql 10 and Dapper built from source, a stub xunit runner, PostgreSQL 18 from conda-forge: domain 119 / web 371 / data 21, Vitest 311, Playwright TOTP end-to-end and 375px layout checks. Not verifiable here: blazor.web.js itself (the Internal.Assets package needs nuget.org).
